name: overgrowth_moves
source: slaythespire.wiki.gg Slay_the_Spire_2 pages, checked 2026-11-01 (Nibbit / Slimes / Shrinker_Beetle / Fuzzy_Wurm_Crawler / Inklet / Mawler / Flyconid / Snapping_Jaxfruit / Vine_Shambler / Fogmog / Cubex_Construct / Slithering_Strangler / Overgrowth / Slimed). Wiki numbers, NOT decompiled values; PR-014 parity must re-verify every entry against the local sts2.dll. Ascension 8+ scalings are recorded in the wiki but not implemented (v0 is A0).

mechanics.Slimed: 1-cost Colorless Status, 'Draw 1 card. Exhaust.' - playable, shuffled into the DISCARD pile by slimes
mechanics.Shrink: the debuffed unit's attacks deal 30% less damage; removed when the applier dies
mechanics.Slippery: the holder's next HP loss is only 1, then the stack is consumed (Inklet starts with 1)
mechanics.Tangled: v0 approximation: a decaying player debuff that surcharges every card by +1 energy per stack
mechanics.Constrict: take X damage at the end of your turn while the applier is alive (block ignored); removed when the applier dies

Nibbit.ai: strict rotation Butt -> Hesitant Slice -> Hiss; solo opens Butt; pair front opens Hesitant Slice, back opens Hiss

M.ai: opens Sticky Shot, then alternates Clump Shot / Sticky Shot
opens Sticky Shot, then 67% Chomp / 33% Sticky, no Sticky twice

ShrinkerBeetle.ai: opens Shrinker, then alternates Chomp / Stomp

FuzzyWurmCrawler.ai: fixed cycle Acid Goop -> Inhale -> Acid Goop

Inklet.ai: outer two open Jab, middle opens Whirlwind; then alternate Jab with an even coin flip between Piercing Gaze and Whirlwind

Mawler.ai: opens Claw, then equal random no-repeat; Roar once per fight

Flyconid.ai: turn 1: 2/3 Frail Spores, 1/3 Smash; then 3/6 Weakening, 2/6 Frail Spores, 1/6 Smash; no-repeat

VineShambler.ai: fixed cycle Swipe -> Grasping Vines -> Chomp

Fogmog.ai: opens Illusory Spores (summon: NOT implemented in v0, logged no-op), then Thwack, then alternates Thwack / Headbutt

excluded_in_v0.reason: summon + revive + Dazed shuffle out of v0 scope

CubexConstruct.ai: Charge Up, then repeat Repeater Blast -> Repeater Blast -> Expel Blast

SlitheringStrangler.ai: opens Constrict, then alternates Constrict with a 50/50 Thwack / Lash

v0_simplifications: Shroom and Slime fixes the random medium slime to Leaf Slime (M)
Strangler and Friend fixes the friend to Snapping Jaxfruit
Fogmog's summon is a logged no-op turn
not_implemented: Ruby Raiders (5 raider types, random trio of 3)
